title: Argentinian Beef Cutlet Empanadas
description: Flaky pastry pockets filled with tender beef cutlet, onions, and spices, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt. Add cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5-7 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch. Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of beef mixture in the center of each dough circle. Brush the edges with beaten egg.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal. Use a fork to crimp the edges.
Place the empanadas on the prepared baking sheet and brush with egg wash.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
